name.value: Lord Stanley Suites On The Park

description.value: Lord Stanley Suites On The Park is a boutique-style service apartment building offering furnished one- and two-bedroom suites located directly beside Stanley Park in downtown Vancouver. The property sits steps from the Coal Harbour Seawall and Stanley Park cycling trails, making it a strategically convenient base for cyclists exploring Vancouver's celebrated waterfront cycling network. The website also notes proximity to bike rentals and the wider Seawall loop.

raw_osm.name: Lord Stanley Suites On The Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's Features page explicitly lists 'Bike storage' as a property amenity, confirming secure overnight bike storage exists on-site. The extended stay page confirms in-suite laundry (washer/dryer) and WiFi access as suite amenities. Multiple website pages reference restaurants and grocery stores within walking distance, confirming those optional amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website phone (604) 688-9299 added from website. Minor toll-free number discrepancy between pages: /about-us/ lists 1-888-767-7829 while /suites/extended-stay/ lists 1-888-767-7629.
Bike storage is listed as a feature but no detail is provided about whether it is locked or otherwise secured beyond the general listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating boutique apartment-hotel adjacent to Stanley Park with confirmed bike storage and strong proximity to Vancouver's primary cycling routes.
